answer: Proof of Stake serves as a garden for secure agent identity, requiring agents to stake capital to validate transactions. To forge fake identities, an attacker must acquire sufficient tokens, turning a simple digital voyage into a costly financial burden. By tying consensus weight to locked resources rather than ephemeral compute cycles, the network ensures that generating sub-identities is prohibitively expensive, as the attacker must exponentially increase their capital to dilute the honest quorum.
